question: In which Gharana do singers perform the Khandhar Vani and Gauhar Vani?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Darbhanga Gharana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Darbhanga Gharana

 
 
• Darbhanga Gharana is known for its distinctive style of singing Dhrupad, which is one of the oldest forms of North Indian classical music.
 
• The Gharana has a rich history and has contributed significantly to the preservation and propagation of Dhrupad music.
 
• Notable features of Darbhanga Gharana include its emphasis on clarity of notes, intricate rhythmic patterns, and powerful vocal delivery.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Some other important Gharana:-**

 
• Jaipur Gharana :

 
 
• The Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana emerged from Alladiya Khan's family which originated from Atrauli and migrated to Jaipur.
 
• The Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana is Hindustani music founded by Alladiya Khan (1855–1946) in the late-19th century.
 
• The Gharana is known for its distinctive vocal aesthetics, raga repertoire, and technical aptitude.
 
• The chief exponents of the Jaipur Gharana are Alladiya Khan, Mallikarjun Mansur, Kesarbhai Kerkar, Kishori Amonkar, Shruti Sadolikar, Padma Talwalkar and Ashwini Bhide Deshpande.
 
 
 
• Patiala Gharana :
 
 
• ‘Patiala Gharana’ is one of the Gharanas in Indian Classical Music, which was founded by Ustad Fateh Ali Khan, and also Ustad Ali Baksh.
 
• Patiala Gharana has both kinds of singing – ‘Thumri’ and ‘Khyal’.
 
• The most famous exponents of Patiala Gharana are Pakistani ghazal singer Gulam Ali, and also the contemporary singer Shafqat Amanat Ali.
 
• Both the Pakistani singers have also garnered enormous fame in India.
 
 
 
• Banaras Gharana :
 
 
• The Benaras Gharana evolved as a result of the great lilting style of khayal singing known by Thumri singers of Benaras and Gaya. 
 
• It was founded by Pt Gopal Mishra.
 
• The chief exponents of the Benaras Gharana are Rajan Mishra, Sajan Mishra, Girija Devi and others. 
 
 
 
• Maihar Gharana :
 
 
• The Maihar Gharana is a Gharana or school of Hindustani classical music, a style of Indian classical music originating in the northern parts of the Indian subcontinent.
